title: FUNCTIONAL STEPS TO DATE — what is live, what a human does to wire the rest.

already_live.what: Git push → Cloudflare Pages. HUD and feed go public.
Proton Mail Bridge. Local SMTP 1025, IMAP 1143.
RustDesk on this machine + mesh relay.
ecoPrimals GitHub profile has a face.

wire_when_you_want_mail_to_land.do: Cloudflare → primals.eco → Email → Email Routing. Create addresses. Catch-all to the inbox Proton already shows you.
MX already points at Cloudflare. Leave it until Stalwart is actually running.

On a vesicle that can hold port 25/587/993: run Stalwart from the draft in hud-deploy/stalwart-config.toml. Put certs in /opt/stalwart/certs. Set STALWART_ADMIN_SECRET. Do not start it on this laptop.
When Stalwart answers: change MX from Cloudflare to that host. Then Proton can leave.
membrane-mailer.py --setup only if the chipmunk must send. Needs an app password. Not required for you to send from Proton today.

wire_giscus_later.do: github.com/apps/giscus → install on ecoPrimals (or ecoPrimal/hud). Enable Discussions on that repo.
giscus.app → pick repo, category. Copy the script tag.
Paste that tag on /abc/ and one paper page. Agent can paste if you hand the snippet.

wire_datacite_later.do: ORCID → Works → Add → Import from other services → DataCite → authorize.
Enable auto-update if you want the NEXT DOI to land itself.
wire_datacite_later.not: do not need it for the two works already public

do_not_wire_tonight: BearDog one-seed mix (lists keys; does not fuse them)
Kanidm / Conduit / Iroh as new cores
order_if_you_keep_going: M3–M4 when a box can hold mail
BearDog mix after the house is quiet
